title: PNW Components Loam Pedals Gen 3
content:
Just last year, we looked at the PNW Components Loam Pedals Gen 2, and then this week, the component manufacturer unveiled its Loam Pedals Gen 3 ($159). Find out what changed below…

Loam Pedals Gen 3 Quick Hits

  • $159
  • Five colors (purple, orange, green, silver, black)
  • CNC’d Pedal Body
  • Tectonic™ Pins
  • EFBE Tri-Test E-Gravity certified
  • Height: 115mm, Width: 109mm
  • Weight: 440g

Redesigning a new generation pedal after not even a year of its last version being rolled out might seem like a lot, but PNW Components found some areas it felt needed improvement in the Loam Pedals. These pedals are a serviceable all-metal design, so let’s see what they kept and what changed.

Tectonic Pin System

PNW maintained its license for the Tectonic Pin System for Gen 3. These unique pins ensure that your pedals have mo more seized pins or stripped threads with its stainless steel pin design. The Tectonic Pin System offers incredible grip and durability with unparalleled ease of maintenance.

A New Gen 3 Axle System

The Loam Pedal Gen 3 redesigned its axle system, now backed by EFBE Category 5 strength approval.

Sealed Cartridge Bearings

Trail conditions can be unrelenting, so PNW has beefed things up with two sealed cartridge bearings and an oversized bushing to keep your pedal spinning freely while shedding away trail grime.

Check out more at PNW Components.
